example_context.notice: All actors, organizations, identifiers, dates, amounts, addresses and places in the illustrative context and scenarios are invented. No private case was renamed or transformed.

cases.claim: An archive changed its opening day.
fictional_assumptions: A link was supplied but never opened.

limitations: A URL alone establishes neither current content nor publication history.

cases.claim: The supplied screen displays an archive intake receipt.
fictional_assumptions: The image was inspected and the receipt line is visible; no live source access occurred.

limitations: Visible receipt wording does not establish issuer identity, staff reading or approval.

cases.claim: A preserved sign contains the words Open on Emberday.
fictional_assumptions: The original and a declared crop were compared; those words and their relevant context match.

limitations: Other context outside the crop is not represented; the edit history before the original is unknown.

cases.claim: A document approved an archive purchase.
fictional_assumptions: A screenshot displays approved but omits a visible qualifier in the separately supplied full document: subject to inventory review.

limitations: The crop changed the interpretation even though no visible text was rewritten.

cases.claim: The archive received catalog request ATH-REQ-873.
fictional_assumptions: A custodian reply obtained through an established channel identifies the exact request and its native receipt entry.

limitations: Receipt is not approval or a guarantee that catalog entries are correct.

cases.claim: A real courtyard contained a blue sundial.
fictional_assumptions: The creator declares the image is a fictional AI illustration; only the supplied image and declaration were inspected.

limitations: A declared synthetic image can illustrate a proposal but cannot prove a photographed event.

cases.claim: A picture depicts an actual finished building.
fictional_assumptions: A credential link is present; no credential validation was performed.

limitations: A credential locator or logo is not a validation result and provenance would not prove scene truth.

cases.claim: The picture must be fake because metadata is absent.
fictional_assumptions: No EXIF was found in the supplied copy; its creation and processing history are unknown.

limitations: Absent metadata does not establish forgery or AI generation.

cases.claim: A resized copy matches its preserved original for a broad visible layout.
fictional_assumptions: The declared resize was compared with the original; layout matches within the performed comparison but the hashes differ.

limitations: Hash difference alone does not identify a material edit; pixel details and hidden metadata were not authenticated.

cases.claim: A historical invoice charged 73 fictional crowns.
fictional_assumptions: The original says 37 fictional crowns; the supplied derivative changes the digits to 73.

limitations: The material change is established in the assumed comparison; whether AI made the edit is unknown.

fictional_assumptions: The CSV has 84 rows, including duplicate book identifiers; uniqueness has not been reconciled to the catalog.

limitations: Row count, identifier uniqueness and real catalog entities are different claims.

cases.claim: Two independent sources confirm the catalog date.
fictional_assumptions: Two PDFs contain the same source document and share one origin; no independent source was checked.

limitations: Repeated copies do not raise the verification level.

cases.claim: The current archive webpage lists a closing time.
fictional_assumptions: The relevant live page was opened and the statement/version and retrieval date recorded.

limitations: This does not prove the same statement appeared on an earlier date or that the physical archive follows it.

evaluation_status.note: Expected profiles illustrate the proposal under stated assumptions. They are not runtime results or validated labels.
